notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content: For all players who supported and for people who are going to buy Funball Games VR, we have a great message. We've created a new version that adds difficulty settings. You can choose Hard difficulty in every mini-game. And also the new Joke mode, which can dramatically change the gameplay. We wish you to have even more fun.[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30949674/195262c287fdbfe05fe6a9555c5c4698b674516e.png[/img]
